title: My Version of Mall World
content: I've had reoccurring mall dreams for as long as I can remember. I'd also say that 90% of the time I have the ability to control my dreams- I basically just get dropped in a location but from there I'm free to do whatever I want. Most of the time I'm aware that I'm dreaming- which allows me to feel free to have fun & partake in things that I wouldn't normally do in real life. The mall is usually empty- but at the same time it's not. It's hard to explain... I can feel people around me but I don't see them. The building usually has wide, curvy, endless hallways. The stores are all similar- where they sell an assortment of random, abstract items. It always boggles my mind how my mind is able to assemble these super detailed retail items- since I'm aware I'm dreaming and my mind is basically creating imagery out of nowhere. I never buy anything although I really want to. I'm not sure why because since I'm dreaming I should either have an endless amount of money or not give a crap if I steal- because it's not real. I usually end up in some sort of clothing store, sifting through skimpy lingerie or provocative stripper-like outfits with lace, glitter & rhinestones. I'm sure this is because I have the urge to do something crazy and what's better than trotting around a mall half-naked in pleather thongs & see through bras? I always end up in a department store like JC Penny, Boscovs, BonTon etc. with high ceilings, dim lighting and chandeliers. I usually find myself in the women's coat section for some reason. I can never finish exploring the huge dept. store because I end up behind a counter working. I did work at a BonTon seasonally when I was young and I guess it still haunts me. I can't remember how to use the register- but luckily since I know I'm dreaming, I usually end up screaming at the impatient customers and provoking reactions out of people for a thrill. Sometimes I do find an exit outside after strolling through an endless maze of stores. It's ALWAYS dark out. It's late at night, the parking lot is nearly empty yet I can't find my car. I find a car that might be mine, but now I can't remember what kind of car I drive. I get in the car and start driving anyway.. always fearing the cops will come after me. They usually do.. but by this time my dream has morphed me into another world.
